summary: Build AI vendor due diligence, contract controls, and monitoring skills in 5 days. Train your team to source AI with stronger governance.
lede: AI procurement and vendor risk management provides a repeatable way to select, evaluate, contract with, and monitor AI suppliers. The course covers vendor classification, structured due diligence, risk scoring, AI-specific contractual safeguards, and ongoing oversight for data, security, performance, and compliance risks. You will build practical workflows, questionnaires, monitoring dashboards, and governance checkpoints that support faster decisions without removing control. The training also helps you document sourcing decisions and communicate clearly with legal, security, finance, business, and audit stakeholders while aligning with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and third-party risk management expectations.
audienceIntro: This AI procurement and vendor risk management course is built for professionals who already touch sourcing, supplier governance, or third-party controls and need a more disciplined way to evaluate AI vendors. It is especially relevant when you are responsible for balancing delivery speed with data protection, model transparency, security assurance, and audit-ready documentation.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of procurement or vendor management processes, contract review basics, and common risk concepts such as likelihood, impact, and control effectiveness. Familiarity with sourcing workflows, supplier scorecards, or third-party risk reviews will help, but no coding is required for completion. Advanced AI concepts are taught at the operational application level, while automated screening and dashboard concepts are introduced conceptually and through guided exercises. You should bring a laptop for workbook-based exercises, and if your organization uses a supplier risk platform or procurement system, you may optionally reference it during class.
